name: A shell command names the Read files it changed
prose: a foreground Bash command that changes a file the model has Read this session (`sed -i`, a formatter, a generator) says so in its own result — "This command changed a file you had Read: … Read it again before you Edit" — instead of leaving the next Edit to be refused as stale with no reason. A file that was already stale before the command is not blamed on it.
invariant: A foreground shell command that changes a file Read this session names that file in its result, and never names one it did not change.
